title: Fill-seam bleed
text: Vector elements built from abutting fills on a magenta ground, drawn with BitmapData.draw at every stage quality and at scale 1 and 3. Where each fill is anti-aliased on its own, the ground shows through the shared edges; AIR and the supersampled Cairo path show no seam.
notes: The "supersampling off" run is the same art without OpenFL's Cairo supersampling (-D openfl_cairo_no_supersample): it shows the bleed the supersampler removes, so it only reports and never fails.
